rule: every whole-file control is decided by both methods over every square, wall and pair; S5 and S6 decide the moved pair or square; an outcome lists only what it states, and every control also requires the two methods to agree on every class they decide

controls.what: square 297 given square 1's pose
square 1 translated by (S, 0)
square 297's entry deleted (JSON and twin)
the side written as 2p/2q (JSON and twin)
square 1's sin moved by 10^-30
every basis (c, s) read as (c, -s): each square reflected in its own horizontal centre line, the rotation read the other way
the twin's side altered in its last digit (3 to 1)
every square transposed: (cx, cy, c, s) to (cy, cx, s, c)
every basis replaced by the square's other edge direction (-s, c)
every basis negated (-c, -s)
the packing turned a quarter about the box centre: (x, y) to (S - y, x), basis (c, s) to (-s, c)
the side lowered by 1/q, one unit of its own last place
the side lowered by 10^-90
the side set to its 12-place floor, 17.739455558288
the side set to its 12-place ceiling, the claim 17.739455558289
square 188 moved toward square 194 along their centre line to exact contact (t = t_contact of the plan facts)
the same, 10^-90 past contact over the slowest binding rate (t = t_past)
every positive pair below 10^-12 (794) closed along its centre line, the second square moving (pair-level, both methods)

outcome.at_contact: margin exactly 0 by A, contact by B
outcome.past: margin exactly the plan's closed-form value by A, overlap by B
